title: Narrowstack Core Instance Manifest
description: Per-tenant configuration commit that drives deploy/destroy/restore of a narrowstack-core instance. See manifest/README.md for the field reference.

tenant_id.description: Stable tenant slug used to name resources and secret paths.

topology.description: T1 = full VM with local Postgres; T2 = semantic layer attached to external warehouse.

vm_size_class.description: Cloud sizing token. Required for T1.

warehouse.description: Warehouse binding. T1 uses a local compose service; T2 attaches to an external DSN via an op:// reference.

mode.description: local => Postgres runs as a compose service on the VM; external => attach to a customer-owned Postgres.

service.description: Compose service name for the local Postgres (mode=local).

volume.description: Named docker volume backing local Postgres (mode=local).

external_dsn_ref.description: op:// reference to the external Postgres DSN (mode=external).

semantics_ref.description: Git ref (tag, branch, or SHA) of narrowstack-semantics to pin.

app_ref.description: Git ref (tag, branch, or SHA) of narrowstack-core-app to pin.

enabled_pipelines.description: Subset of dlt source names to load for this instance.

allowlist_profile.description: Name of the allowlist profile enforced at the deploy gate (maps to narrowstack-semantics allowlist/<profile>.yaml).

provider_mode.description: Provider mode per the provider spec.

telemetry_grants.description: Explicit telemetry grants. Default [] means T0 (no telemetry active).

backup.description: Backup target + retention. Required for T1.

target_ref.description: op:// reference to the backup target (bucket/DSN + credentials).

secrets_refs.description: Map of logical secret name -> op:// item path. Never contains values.

opRef.description: 1Password secret reference. Must be an op:// path, never a literal value.
